---
title: "Bioassay Analysis Report (Compact)"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: true
      smooth_scroll: true
    theme: flatly
    css: report_style.css
  word_document:
    toc: true
    fig_caption: true
    fig_width: 6
    fig_height: 4
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{fancyhdr}
  - \pagestyle{fancy}
  - \fancyfoot[C]{\thepage}
  - \fancyhead{}
  - \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
params:
  output_dir: NULL
  lang: "en"
  compact: true
  stats_env: !r new.env(parent = emptyenv())
---

<!--
================================================================================
Compact orchestration template (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §H4 split).

This is a thin wrapper around `unified_analysis_template.Rmd`. The compact
variant reuses the full template's chunk pipeline; presentation-only
chunks that are unhelpful in the 3-5 page summary form
(weight-comparison, model-stability-assessment, standard-backcalculation,
plate-positional-qc, parallelism-assessment, tissue-normalization-
traceability, exclusion-audit) are gated by `eval=!is_compact` in that
template, so setting `compact: true` here in this file's params block
suppresses them automatically.

The H4 RDS cache (.fit_all_models_cache.rds, .quantify_samples_cache.rds)
is shared with the detailed template via output_dir, so when both
variants are rendered in the same render_reports() call the heavy
compute (LL.4 fit + delta-method per-well predictions) runs only once.
================================================================================
-->

```{r child = "unified_analysis_template.Rmd"}
```
